verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail's marketing says it offers 'API integrations' and that you can 'use APIs to connect your virtual mailbox to the tools you already use' so mail stays in sync, and it confirms high-resolution digital scans exist. But the pack has no public API reference and no evidence of endpoints for listing mail items or downloading scans; the API claim is a homepage-level mention only. Missing for 10: documented public API reference, explicit mail-item listing endpoint, scan/PDF download endpoint, authentication/developer docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
